title: Keto Crunchy Portuguese Beef Burger
description: A spicy, crunchy twist on the classic Portuguese beef burger, using ground allspice and infuse-oil, perfect for a keto diet. This burger is sure to be a hit with its nostalgic flavor and satisfying crunch.

ingredients.name: Infuse oil
ingredients.notes: infuse with chili peppers and garlic

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Form the ground beef into 4 patties.
In a small bowl, mix together the infuse oil, chili peppers, and allspice.
Brush the mixture onto the beef patties.
Season the patties with salt and pepper.
Grill the patties for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired doneness.
Meanwhile, mix together the eggs and breadcrumbs in a separate bowl.
Form the egg mixture into small patties.
Grill the egg patties for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Assemble the burgers by placing a beef patty on the bottom bun, followed by a few slices of cheddar cheese, a few egg patties, and finally the top bun.
